method: Executed the extracted lesson server against JSON-RPC shape, schema-invalid, successful, and no-data fixtures; executed the extracted host adapter against a fake MCP response; compiled all lesson Python fences. Official MCP Tools and Transports pages were reviewed for normative claims.

observations.trace: W6 verifier 14/14; published client/server temporary-directory round-trip passed; prior server review verifier 7 paths passed. The valid-but-unavailable weather result is isError=true; invalid enum uses MCP isError; non-object args return -32602; host mapping forwards is_error and joins text blocks.

limitations: The tests exercise local teaching code and fixtures only; no official MCP SDK interoperability, Streamable HTTP transport, production host authorization, or external side effects were tested.
Historical SDK 2.3.0 interoperability notes refer to earlier code and were not rerun.
The text-only host adapter does not implement image/audio/resource/structuredContent conversion; production adapters must honor the downstream model API contract.
MCP tool-name rules are SHOULD recommendations in the reviewed 2026-07-28 Tools specification; provider/API constraints can differ.
